description: Research a keyword and related terms. Returns up to 10 rows — the seed keyword plus the store's top autocomplete suggestions — each with difficulty (0-100), popularity score, and results count. Use this to find keywords worth targeting; for metrics on terms you already know, sonar_keyword_metrics is cheaper. On prepaid API credits it costs 10 credits per call (rows that could not be computed are refunded); it needs a Sonar API key or connected account and is not part of the free tier. Answers within about 30 seconds. Each row carries `measured_at` (difficulty) and `popularity_measured_at` (popularity, can be older), ISO 8601 UTC; `stale: true` means at least one of them is older than 7 days. A related term that couldn't be computed in time is re-checked while the call's time budget allows (through the metrics endpoint, 1 credit per keyword served); one still not ready comes back marked `pending` (queued, not charged) — get it later with sonar_keyword_metrics.

country.description: One of Sonar's 72 keyword-research markets, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "us", "gb", "de", "jp", "br"). Keyword data isn't available for other storefronts. Default "us".

store.description: App store. "ios" for Apple App Store, "android" for Google Play.
